characters.name: Darrow
characters.description: A former Red miner who was recently hanged and survived to be recruited by the Sons of Ares. He is mourning the loss of his wife, Eo, and feels like a hollow shell of his former self.
key_events: Survived his own execution via hanging
Drugged and buried by Uncle Narol
Rescued by the Sons of Ares from an abandoned mine
Agreed to accompany Harmony and Ralph to meet Dancer

characters.name: Harmony
characters.description: A high-ranking member of the Sons of Ares with a distinctive scarred face and a cruel, cold demeanor. She acts as the leader of the extraction team that retrieves Darrow.
key_events: Revealed her identity and the existence of a mission from Ares

characters.name: Ralph
characters.description: A timid and nervous member of the Sons of Ares who seems frightened of Darrow. He is subordinate to Harmony and struggles with maintaining the group's secrecy.
key_events: Assisted in the extraction of Darrow
Accidentally revealed the name of their leader, Dancer

characters.name: Uncle Narol
characters.description: Darrow's uncle who performed the execution and the subsequent burial of Darrow. It is revealed he drugged Darrow to ensure his survival.
key_events: Faked Darrow's death to facilitate his recruitment by the Sons of Ares

characters.name: Dancer
characters.description: The mysterious leader of the Sons of Ares chapter who ordered Darrow's recruitment.

characters.name: Eo
characters.description: Darrow's late wife whose death serves as his primary emotional motivation. She represents the hope for a better future that Darrow continues to hold onto.
key_events: Died prior to the chapter events

relationships.description: Hostile and tense; Harmony treats Darrow like a pawn while Darrow holds a physical threat over her for information.
moments: Darrow grabbed Harmony's hand and forced her to remove her mask

relationships.description: Darrow realizes Narol manipulated the execution to save him, revealing a secret alliance between Narol and the Sons of Ares.
moments: Darrow realizes the lethargy in his veins was caused by Narol drugging him

relationships.description: Harmony is the superior figure who shows open disdain for Ralph's incompetence and nervousness.
moments: Harmony sighing and correcting Ralph after he accidentally mentions Dancer's name

world_facts.name: Sons of Ares
world_facts.description: A subversive underground group working against the existing order, characterized by the use of masks and specialized utility vehicles.

world_facts.name: The Vale
world_facts.description: A Red cultural belief about the afterlife where deceased loved ones wait in a green space.

world_facts.name: Mars Underground
world_facts.description: The subterranean environment where Red miners live and work, containing tunnels, ventilation systems, and utility roads.

summary: Chapter 7, titled 'Lazarus', follows Darrow as he awakens in an abandoned mine after being presumed dead following his execution. He realizes he was drugged by his Uncle Narol rather than killed, serving as a tactical deception to keep him alive. He is quickly intercepted by two members of the Sons of Ares, Harmony and the nervous Ralph, who travel in a specialized tumbler vehicle. During the journey, Harmony reveals that their leader, Ares, has a specific mission for Darrow, though Darrow remains emotionally paralyzed by the death of his wife, Eo. Harmony removes her mask, revealing a horribly scarred face, and they transport Darrow to a hidden facility to meet their local leader, Dancer. Darrow struggles with grief and confusion, unsure if he should trust these individuals or if he should have simply remained dead, but he decides to proceed because he carries the memory of Eo's wishes for a better future.
